pr.title: P8c: offline Watchlist signal outbox
pr.body:
RW-01 fixes a writer/verifier invariant mismatch: independently valid P5a/P5b sources with the same watch_id/revision but different complete entries could both record and make verify/backup fail. The writer now completes one semantic fold inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE and rejects new incompatible entries with identity_conflict/exit2 before insertion. Corruption and same-ID replay conflict precedence are preserved; frozen schemas/identities/deadlines and prior source writers are unchanged.

Corrected candidate d82aba73d9bc0eb455f8664e3ccddc0134ea9d9c, tree dfd0414242cff364aad6082411ae88aef728783e. Exact unchanged pre-fix executable now passes;35new regressions,2250fulltests/1existing platform skip,94.15%line/88.31%branch. New independent QA17cases(default2/explicit5) and distinct REVIEWER28(default2)/all13files PASS.

Four new jobs PASS in attempt1, all12harnesses and RW01 rejection in wheel/Compose/AMD64/ARM64-QEMU. [New CI](https://github.com/KastaTM/card-market-tracker/actions/runs/40685550482), [complete corrective report](https://github.com/KastaTM/card-market-tracker/blob/57bdf94391be307197df2a59526acf59bc6ff681/docs/evidence/P8C_RW01_d82aba73/RW01_CORRECTIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md), [fresh reviews](https://github.com/KastaTM/card-market-tracker/blob/57bdf94391be307197df2a59526acf59bc6ff681/docs/evidence/P8C_RW01_d82aba73/INDEPENDENT_REVIEWS.md).
Lead publicly read back58artifacts and49changed source/document blobs byte-for-byte. Evidence is separate; source HEAD is unchanged.

LocalQEMU timing unavailable at documented Docker check; physicalPi not certified. Full write-time fold may timeout at capacity under unchanged2s/5s Budget. Previously corrupt stores are not repaired automatically. Old candidate/CI/READY records remain historical and superseded.

P8c OPEN / REWORK_REQUIRED, awaiting Phase Lead review. Prior READY is not automatically restored. PR retained draft/unmerged; no phase closure or new phase.

accepted_commit.message: fix: preserve watchlist entry invariant on outbox admission
